verdict.rationale: Unit is a banking-as-a-service platform with a Dashboard and APIs, so a built-in AI assistant for delegating tasks is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI assistant, copilot, or agent inside the Dashboard or product; the evidence covers only accounts, payments, cards, lending, managed solutions, and webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
